summary: Enhance your knowledge with our Soil Conservation and Sustainable Land Management Training. Learn effective practices for a healthier environment and future.
lede: Soil conservation and sustainable land management help practitioners assess land degradation, reduce erosion and support productive land use. Designed for land stewards, planners, consultants and agricultural advisers, the course covers land capability assessment, soil-loss modeling, and planning vegetative and structural conservation measures. It also develops skills in soil-health monitoring, runoff control and reporting progress from field data.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is designed for professionals responsible for the stewardship, regulation, and productive use of land resources across diverse sectors.
audience: Natural Resource Analysts using GIS for land
modules: Land Degradation Assessment and LDN Frameworks
Erosion Modeling and Quantitative Risk Assessment
Soil Health Monitoring and Carbon Sequestration
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of environmental science, geography, or agriculture. Familiarity with basic GIS concepts and field-based data collection is recommended but not required. No prior experience with erosion modeling software is necessary.
